"use client";

import { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { Heart, Check } from "lucide-react";

export function InterestButton({ startupId, startupName }: { startupId: string; startupName: string }) {
  const [sent, setSent] = useState(false);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [checking, setChecking] = useState(true);
  const [message, setMessage] = useState("");
  const [showMessage, setShowMessage] = useState(false);

  // Check if already sent interest on mount
  useEffect(() => {
    fetch("/api/interest")
      .then(r => r.json())
      .then(data => {
        const alreadySent = (data.interests || []).some(
          (i: { startupId?: string }) => i.startupId === startupId
        );
        if (alreadySent) setSent(true);
      })
      .catch(() => {})
      .finally(() => setChecking(false));
  }, [startupId]);

  async function handleInterest() {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch("/api/interest", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ startupId, message: message || null }),
      });
      if (res.ok) setSent(true);
    } catch { /* ignore */ }
    finally { setLoading(false); }
  }

  if (checking) {
    return (
      <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)] border border-[var(--border)] rounded-md">
        Loading...
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (sent) {
    return (
      <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 text-xs font-medium bg-[var(--green-muted)] text-[var(--green)] rounded-md border border-[var(--green)]/20">
        <Check size={12} /> Interest sent
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-2">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
        <button
          onClick={() => (showMessage ? handleInterest() : setShowMessage(true))}
          disabled={loading}
          className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 text-xs font-medium bg-[var(--accent)] text-[#171717] rounded-md hover:bg-[var(--accent-hover)] disabled:opacity-50 transition-colors"
        >
          <Heart size={12} />
          {loading ? "Sending..." : "I'm Interested"}
        </button>
        {showMessage && !loading && (
          <button onClick={handleInterest} className="text-[10px] text-[var(--text-muted)] hover:text-[var(--text-secondary)]">
            Skip & send
          </button>
        )}
      </div>
      {showMessage && (
        <input
          type="text"
          value={message}
          onChange={(e) => setMessage(e.target.value)}
          placeholder="Optional: Add a short note..."
          className="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-md border border-[var(--border)] bg-[var(--bg-card)] text-[var(--text)] text-xs placeholder:text-[var(--text-muted)] focus:outline-none focus:border-[var(--border-hover)] transition-colors"
          onKeyDown={(e) => { if (e.key === "Enter") handleInterest(); }}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

export function normalizeText(value: string | null | undefined): string {
  if (!value) return "";
  return value
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/&/g, " and ")
    .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, " ")
    .replace(/\s+/g, " ")
    .trim();
}

function containsPhrase(haystack: string, phrase: string): boolean {
  const normalized = normalizeText(phrase);
  if (!normalized) return false;
  return ` ${haystack} `.includes(` ${normalized} `);
}

/** Capability ids explicitly mentioned in a free-text field. */
export function detectCapabilities(
  value: string | null | undefined
): Set<string> {
  const text = normalizeText(value);
  const found = new Set<string>();
  if (!text) return found;
  for (const capability of CAPABILITIES) {
    if (capability.keywords.some((keyword) => containsPhrase(text, keyword))) {
      found.add(capability.id);
    }
  }
  return found;
}

export function detectCapabilitiesInList(
  values: (string | null | undefined)[] | null | undefined
): Set<string> {
  const found = new Set<string>();
  for (const value of values ?? []) {
    for (const id of detectCapabilities(value)) found.add(id);
  }
  return found;
}

export function detectAudiences(values: (string | null | undefined)[]): Set<AudienceId> {
  const text = normalizeText(values.filter(Boolean).join(" "));
  const found = new Set<AudienceId>();
  if (!text) return found;
  for (const [id, keywords] of Object.entries(AUDIENCE_KEYWORDS) as [

    if (keywords.some((keyword) => containsPhrase(text, keyword))) found.add(id);
  }
  return found;
}

import {
  getStartupActor,
} from "@/features/matchmaking/access";
import {
  getRecommendationsForStartup,
  matchErrorPayload,
  setRecommendationState,
  type RecommendationStateAction,
  type RecommendationView,
} from "@/features/matchmaking";
import type { MatchStrength } from "@/features/matchmaking/types";

const VIEWS: RecommendationView[] = ["all", "saved", "dismissed"];
const STRENGTHS: MatchStrength[] = ["high", "good", "possible"];
const ACTIONS: RecommendationStateAction[] = ["dismiss", "restore", "save", "unsave"];

const PRIVATE_HEADERS = { "Cache-Control": "private, no-store" };

// GET /api/recommendations?view=&strength=&type=&sector=&page=&limit=
export async function GET(request: Request) {
  const actor = await getStartupActor();
  if (!actor) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "Only startup accounts can discover business connections." },
      { status: 403 }
    );
  }

  const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);
  const viewParam = searchParams.get("view") as RecommendationView | null;
  const strengthParam = searchParams.get("strength") as MatchStrength | null;

  const data = await getRecommendationsForStartup(actor.startup.id, {
    view: viewParam && VIEWS.includes(viewParam) ? viewParam : "all",
    strength:
      strengthParam && STRENGTHS.includes(strengthParam) ? strengthParam : "all",
    relationshipType: searchParams.get("type") ?? "all",
    sector: searchParams.get("sector") ?? "all",
    page: Number(searchParams.get("page") ?? "1") || 1,
    limit: Number(searchParams.get("limit") ?? "12") || 12,
  });

  return NextResponse.json(data, { headers: PRIVATE_HEADERS });
}

// POST /api/recommendations { targetStartupId, action }
// Only dismiss/save state can be written from the client. Recommendations
// themselves are created exclusively by the server-side engine.
export async function POST(request: Request) {
  const actor = await getStartupActor();
  if (!actor) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "Only startup accounts can manage recommendations." },
      { status: 403 }
    );
  }

  try {
    const body = await request.json().catch(() => ({}));
    const targetStartupId =
      typeof body.targetStartupId === "string" ? body.targetStartupId : "";
    const action = body.action as RecommendationStateAction;

    if (!ACTIONS.includes(action)) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "Unknown recommendation action.", code: "INVALID_ACTION" },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    const state = await setRecommendationState(
      actor.startup.id,
      targetStartupId,
      action
    );
    return NextResponse.json({ ok: true, state }, { headers: PRIVATE_HEADERS });
  } catch (error) {
    const { status, body } = matchErrorPayload(error);
    return NextResponse.json(body, { status });
  }
}
